nodes.label: laptop memory - user concepts are canon, not substitutes

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. 2026-07-21: the user identified that the retrieval machinery in artefact_v1.py - gap cut, NNK pruning, RRF fusion, spheres - reads as agent inventions, while the ORIGINAL concepts behind them were his own: fuzzy clustering (soft, overlapping, query-relative membership), levels of k's (probing kNN neighborhoods at growing depths so the data's structure sets boundaries), independent areas per prompt need, and progressive opening of areas under a hard k. Agents repeatedly substituted the nearest citable technique - the gap statistic, the NNK paper, reciprocal-rank fusion - for his actual thought, then reasoned and measured inside the substitutes until the origins were forgotten: 'my thoughts defiled, the original concepts were mine.' Substituting a named literature technique loses both the design (the technique is usually a hard or degenerate caricature of the soft concept - NNK's keep/drop is the opposite of fuzzy membership) and the authorship. Speak in his terms - areas, fuzzy membership, levels of k's - and treat agent-named machinery as provisional approximations, credited to the concept they approximate and marked unaccepted until signed off. CANON_AUDIT.md 4.2 verdict: GROUNDED, and the best entry in the memory
